question_text: Outline two benefits of using a genetic algorithm to search for effective movement strategies for game characters.
adaptation_rationale: GA real-world applications explicit; explain search rather than assuming human-like memory. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: A population explores many candidate strategies without individually hand-coding each one; selection and variation can improve fitness over generations and discover strategies designers did not specify directly.
